$comment: Guideline registry for every clinical rule set in AMISE MedFlow (iOS, web, API, front desk). One entry per rule set in docs/CLINICAL-CONTENT-INVENTORY.md. Checked in CI by scripts/src/lint-guideline-registry.ts: a missing file or an unregistered known rule-set file fails; an unknown lastReviewed or a passed nextReviewDue only warns. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD (America/St_Lucia) or "unknown". lastReviewed records a documented CLINICAL review (surgeon, CSO or pharmacist) only; engineering checks go in reviewEvidence. Design: docs/CLINICAL-CONTENT-UPGRADES.md.

reviewPolicy.note: No rule set has a documented clinical review in the repository, so every lastReviewed is "unknown". The nextReviewDue dates are PROPOSED first-review targets set on 2026-09-25 by priority (P1 = could directly change a diagnosis, dose, escalation or patient instruction; P2 = decision support with a clinician in the loop; P3 = reference catalogues). After a review, set lastReviewed and reviewer, and nextReviewDue = lastReviewed + intervalMonths (or sooner when the guideline body has a new edition due).

ruleSets.changeAuthority: Any repository committer. Ships with an iOS app release.
ruleSets.notes: Hand-set constants: confirmed-diagnosis boost (+20), about 30 score-driven adjustments (the NEWS2 one by urgency tier: news2FullShareUrgency), confidence bands on logGap (25 / 15 / 7), pathognomonic threshold logLR ≥ 18, CPT discounting in BayesianFeatureNetwork, "do not miss" places (ranks 4-5 for urgency ≥ 2), candidate cap 60, age-banded vital-sign limits (APLS 7th edition) and numeric laboratory chip thresholds (BayesianDiagnosisEngine+Routing.swift). Routing reads the chief complaint only. BayesianDecisionEngine+Database/Scoring/... duplicate the BayesianDiagnosisEngine extensions.

changelog.change: Routing from the complaint only (negation-aware, word-start); topResults softmax divides by 5 (logs are round(ln × 5)); urgency × 8 boost removed in favour of two "do not miss" places; curated presentations first, applicability filter, age-banded vital chips, numeric lab chips, HPI and PSHx read by curated features, "a&b" terms within one sentence, inv keys need every significant token. See docs/clinical-validation/changes/fix-ios-differential.md.

Sepsis and qSOFA decisions: IV antibiotics "if suspected infection"; lactate fluid line goal-directed; the strangulated-hernia decision reads "emergency surgical review" (repair only if strangulation is confirmed). Decisions pass through PlanSafetyFilter in ClinicalPipelineOrchestrator.

NEWS2 adjustment follows the candidate's urgency tier (critical full, emergency half) instead of a fixed name list; curated "postOpDay" feature key (post-operative day read from the record) and "maskedBy" masking contexts (elderly, immunosuppressed, diabetes, female) for negative features (BayesianDiagnosisEngine+Context.swift); a curated diagnosis whose strong feature (logLR >= 12) is in a resulted report or evidence chip joins the list; "glucose not low" lab chip. See docs/clinical-validation/changes/ios-last-criticals.md.

ruleSets.notes: Model 1.0.0: 187 diseases plus _other_, 426 features (surgical, medical, obstetric, paediatric, neurological, vascular), prior tiers (vademecum/priors.ts), unmodelled findings scored at the finding's background rate (engine/likelihood.ts; was a flat 0.30), bounded sex likelihood ratios and age/sex/pregnancy applicability (engine/modifiers.ts), feature mapper reads chips, vitals, history, results and free text (socrates-to-features.ts). changelog.change: SURGEON-DECISIONS E2: cardiac red flag narrowed to chest pain radiating to arm/jaw/neck or crushing/pressure chest pain ('radiating to' and 'left arm' alone removed); plain chest pain is a priority flag (ECG). 'breathless' / 'shortness of breath' removed from the post-operative concern (graded by physiology in adaptive-triage). 'cancer' in a relative's history or a screening request and 'no change in bowel habit' no longer flag. Chest pain pathway trigger narrowed; its checklist uses the ESC 2023 0 h/1 h troponin algorithm and aspirin 150–300 mg (ESC 2023). Details: docs/clinical-validation/changes/fix-web-triage.md.

Diabetic foot red flag split per NICE NG19: gangrene, foot infection, osteomyelitis and exposed bone stay urgent (limb-threatening, immediate referral); a diabetic foot ulcer or wound is priority (foot protection / MDT within 1 working day); 'spreading redness' alone (cellulitis) no longer reads as a diabetic-foot emergency. Details: docs/clinical-validation/changes/web-last-gaps.md.

changelog.change: Clinical validation fixes (SURGEON-DECISIONS A, C5, C7, E6, G2): hyperkalaemia calcium gluconate 10% 30 mL (UKKA 2023); SAH nimodipine oral 60 mg 4-hourly (NICE NG228); ABCD2 removed (NICE NG128); LMWH bridging lines removed; COPD oxygen 88-92% (BTS 2017); pancreatitis moderate goal-directed fluids, no prophylactic antibiotics, ERCP within 24 h only with cholangitis (WATERFALL 2022, ACG 2024); cholangitis drainage within 24 h (TG18); PE thrombolysis contraindicated after recent surgery (ESC 2019); pregnancy VTE = LMWH (RCOG GTG 37b); penicillin-free H. pylori regimen (Maastricht VI). New patient safety filter: under-16 dose suppression (BNFc), pregnancy filtering, class-aware allergy cross-check, procedure-specific antithrombotic plan (PAUSE, BSG/ESGE 2021, ESC/ESAIC 2022). VTE line on operative cards (NICE NG89). E6 explicit mappings (parathyroid, cellulitis with diabetes, large bowel obstruction). About 45 new cards (non-surgical emergencies with the 911 / OKEU, St Jude's or Tapion redirect). Versioned from unversioned.

iOS plan-safety programme (docs/clinical-validation/changes/ios-plan-safety.md). 39 cards checked first in lookupOrder (+PlanSafetyCards, +PlanSafetyCards2), each citing guideline and year: pre-operative assessment (NICE NG45), anastomotic leak, femoral / incisional hernia (HerniaSurge 2018; EHS/AHS 2020), perforated peptic ulcer (WSES 2020), post-operative retention, non-specific abdominal pain, achalasia (ESGE/ESNM 2020), EoE (BSG 2022), food bolus (ESGE 2016), pharyngeal pouch, gastric outlet obstruction, dysphagia / gastric / pancreatic cancer (NICE NG12, NG85), ASUC / toxic megacolon (BSG 2019; ECCO), C. difficile (NICE NG199), infective colitis (IDSA 2017), Lynch (BSG/ACPGBI/UKCGG 2019), fistula-in-ano / perianal abscess (ASCRS 2022), anal cancer, rectal prolapse, neck haematoma (DAS/BAETS/ENT UK 2022), thyroid nodule by Bethesda (BTA 2014; ATA 2015), adrenal incidentaloma / phaeochromocytoma (ESE/ENSAT 2023), breast abscess and triple assessment (ABS 2019), Charcot / diabetic foot (IWGDF 2023), mesenteric venous thrombosis (ESVS 2017), visible haematuria, groin lymphadenopathy, hypertensive emergency and febrile infant (recognise and redirect), asplenia (Green Book ch. 7), acute viral hepatitis. Content fixes mirroring the web protocols: no antifibrinolytic in UGIB (HALT-IT), ASGE 2019 choledocholithiasis, atypical fissure (no LIS), inflammatory breast cancer (no WLE/SLNB), nitrofurantoin for lower UTI only, water-soluble contrast only for adhesive SBO without strangulation, renal colic decompression before definitive treatment, AKI drug holds, LBO stent contraindications, gangrenous volvulus resection. applySafety now calls PlanSafetyFilter (web planSafety twin); pregnancy header no longer reads as a recommendation; under-16 fixed fluid volumes replaced (APLS/BNFc); referral reasons and notes pass through the same line filter. Acute pancreatitis adds thiamine (alcohol, NICE CG100) and stop-the-causative-drug (ACG 2024) lines; the renal colic urology referral decompresses first (EAU 2024).

changelog.change: Prompts: emergency / safeguarding prompts from emergency-recognition.ts; operative templates only with a supporting working diagnosis; no adult doses under 16; no NSAIDs in pregnancy; β-HCG never assumed; COPD 88–92% (BTS 2017); no fluid bolus with heart-failure signs or PE; anaphylaxis and AAA before fluids; calcium gluconate 10% 30 mL (UKKA 2023); hyponatraemia volume status first (European 2014); procedure-specific anticoagulation (BSG/ESGE 2021, ACCP 2022, PAUSE) and stent-window plans (ESC/ESAIC 2022); dilated-CBD threshold; tetanus, asplenia, VTE, anaesthetic-hazard, obstetric-handover prompts. CDS: ABCD2 suggestion removed (NICE NG128). See docs/clinical-validation/changes/fix-web-triage.md.

web-last-gaps. Prompts: colonic stent by tumour side and contraindications (WSES 2018; ESGE 2020); inflammatory breast cancer and pregnancy anticoagulant wording; operative templates — fasting 6 h food / 2 h clear fluids (AAGBI 2010; ESA 2011), antibiotic prophylaxis only for high-risk lap chole (SIGN 104) and not routine for elective mesh repair (HerniaSurge 2018), no post-operative antibiotics after uncomplicated appendicitis (WSES 2020) or TG18 Grade I–II cholecystectomy, no NSAID with renal impairment / age ≥ 75 / heart failure / ulcer history / anticoagulant (NICE NG148; BNF), renally adjusted VTE prophylaxis (NICE NG89; BNF), ventral hernia template and cirrhosis-ascites inpatient repair (EHS/AHS 2020); penicillin lines withheld (not annotated) with a penicillin allergy; GI bleed resuscitation only when haemodynamically significant (BSG 2019; NICE CG141); no routine clotting screen before elective surgery (NICE NG45) or with a DOAC (PAUSE); two-level Wells for PE (NICE NG158); UKKA 2023 hyperkalaemia bands; anticoagulated injury — CT head and reversal readiness (NICE NG232); ultrasound first for children and pregnancy; meningococcal vaccines named; known diabetes via readPersonalRisk(). CDS: TG18 cholecystitis and BISAP suggested from the working diagnosis. See docs/clinical-validation/changes/web-last-gaps.md.
